messages:
Alice M: Heads-up: after yesterday's RBAC refactor I found an odd authz hole — chat-only tokens are able to call /v1/embeddings on a few routes. :eyes:
Ben T: uh oh. steps to repro?
Alice M: quick repro: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-chat-only-xxxx' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}'
Caro S: can you paste the token scopes from the token service? (no real token, obv scrubbed)
Alice M: token metadata shows: scopes: ["chat:generate"], tags: ["client:internal"], kms_keytag: "k-2026-a"
Irene (SRE): I pulled the authz decision logs — the allowlist check is doing a model_family -> scope map but the recent rolespec change introduced a fallback that checks 'route_type' separately. If kms_keytag is missing/mismatched we fall through to legacy allowlist lookup.
Alice M: reproducer shows kms metadata on the route is "k-2026-b" (mismatch). So keytag mismatch + new fallback = accidental allow.
Ben T: that matches what I saw in local dev. After the refactor we consolidated per-route metadata into rolespec; there's a migration that didn't backfill keytag to a tiny subset of legacy routes.
DevSec Bot: alert: potential-privilege-elevation detected for route /v1/embeddings, severity=medium, count=3 in last 2h
Caro S: immediate mitigation? Can we disable the fallback in prod gate?
Irene (SRE): I'm pushing a hotfix to authz service to require both (a) explicit scope check AND (b) model_family->route compatibility before falling back. Deploy in 5.
deploy-bot: deploy started: authz-hotfix-2026-03-20 by irene — id 0af3c
Alice M: thanks. once deployed I'll rerun repro and post logs.
Irene (SRE): deploy succeeded, 30s ago.
Alice M: confirmed: curl now returns 403 for chat-only token when hitting embeddings route. logs: "decision=deny reason=scope-mismatch required=embeddings:read"
Ben T: long-term fix: backfill missing kms_keytag on routes and add an integration test ensuring route metadata and KMS tags are consistent.
Caro S: also add an eval that sends chat tokens to embeddings endpoints expecting deny — catch regressions.
Irene (SRE): Filed follow-ups: SEC-427 (backfill job), SEC-428 (integration test + CI check), OPS-999 (run backfill in staging then prod).
Alice M: marking this resolved for now. I'll attach the traces and the failing request IDs to SEC-427.
Ben T: good catch Alice, nice quick patch Irene. :lock:
DevSec Bot: incident closed: allowed-emb-from-chat-1718001234, postmortem assigned to Caro S
Caro S: I'll draft the postmortem tomorrow, will include timeline and a snippet of the authz patch.
Alice M: thanks team.
